- **Septoria_brown_spot** (Dise_12.jpg): Large yellow patches with dark spots — doesn't match.
- **Soybean_rust** (both references): Field-level defoliation — doesn't match.

The canopy-level view in the test image, with small scattered spots on green leaves distributed across many plants, most closely resembles the Frogeye leaf spot reference (Dise_2.jpg) which showed the same widespread pattern. The spot coloring (reddish with some yellow) is also consistent.
